# @agilebot/vitepress-preset

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@agilebot/vitepress-preset?color=444&label=)](https://npmjs.com/package/@agilebot/vitepress-preset)

## Usage

```bash
npm install --save-dev @agilebot/vitepress-preset
```

```ts
// .vitepress/config/index.ts
import { withAgilebotConfig } from '@agilebot/vitepress-preset/config';

export default await withAgilebotConfig({
  docRoot: '/path/to/doc',
  vpRoot: 'path/to/doc/.vitepress',
  title: 'My Site',
  description: 'My Site Description'
});

// .vitepress/config/theme/index.ts
import { withAgilebotTheme } from '@agilebot/vitepress-preset/theme';

export default withAgilebotTheme();
```

## Export PDF

Quickly export your VitePress documentation as a PDF.

```ts
import { exportPdf } from '@agilebot/vitepress-preset/pdf';

await exportPdf({
  docRoot: '/path/to/doc',
  outFile: 'output.pdf'
  // lang: 'en',
  // routePatterns: []
});
```

- `docRoot`: Docs root directory
- `outFile`: Output PDF file name
